title: musiChain
tagline: Discover a revolutionary music app that tackles income inequality, offers engaging challenges, and rewards users with NFT collectibles. Experience fair artist compensation, secure licensing, and a unique platform that reshapes the music industry. 🎵🌟
description: Our project is aiming to create a fair and not user-consuming space to simply listen to music. An area where artists will earn what they deserve and users will be rewarded. %80 Of earnings - which in various ways - will be given to the artists. For example a user listened 100 song in a month and his/her %80 of subscription price proportionally shared between artists (s)he have listened. Album covers will be NFT's. Also songs will be NFT's and anyone will be able to own them and showcase in his/her profile. By buying the particular song NFT simply helping the artist cause most of the income goes to the artist. Producer will have the chance to sell the music that they created and as they sell the song to somebody, the earning that particular song makes goes to the new owner. Ownership brings NFT's of course. NFT's are appealing for everyone. Users will be able to display the NFT of the concert that they've been. Yes, POAP's are here! Users also will have the chance to put NFT's for their profile photos. Most listened users will be rewarded by NFT's with certain features. To keep users here everyday we're incentivizing them to have day streaks, if user listens a song for 30 days in a row will be rewarded with an NFT. And will be noticed with a push protocol. Data will be kept off-chain but for the authority of tx signatures of tx's will be kept in-chain of course.
how_its_made:
To build this revolutionary music app, we utilized a combination of cutting-edge technologies and innovative solutions. Here's a detailed breakdown of the components and how they were pieced together:

Decentralized structure: Our platform leverages decentralization to ensure fair compensation for artists, addressing income inequality in the music industry.

Blockchain and NFTs: We utilized blockchain technology for secure and straightforward music licensing. Non-fungible tokens (NFTs) were employed for various purposes, such as collectible rewards and digital concert tickets.

Scroll Network and zk-rollup technology: We built the app on the Scroll Network, which provides a fast, secure, and scalable solution for our platform. We also integrated zk-rollup technology to enhance transaction efficiency and maintain a high level of security.

Front-end development with React: For an intuitive and responsive user interface, we used React. This popular front-end library allowed us to create a seamless user experience while maintaining a clean and maintainable codebase.

Sponsor technologies: We incorporated any relevant sponsor technologies that complemented our app's features, enhancing its overall functionality and performance.

Hacky solutions: Throughout the development process, we tackled several challenges and came up with creative solutions to optimize the user experience, streamline the music licensing process, and effectively distribute tokens among artists based on user engagement.

By bringing together these technologies and solutions, we created a music application that stands out in the industry. Our platform not only addresses significant issues like income inequality and secure music licensing but also offers unique features and innovations that revolutionize the way artists and fans interact.
